summary: First testing run in this fork. Validated backend APIs via pytest (8/8 passed) and frontend flows via Playwright. All user-facing features work end-to-end: intro splash video renders and Skip Intro dismisses it, all 6 routes (/, /wheels, /aero, /programmes, /about, /contact) render content without console errors, intro does not reappear on in-session navigation, AI chat widget streams a real VAD-relevant Gemini answer (mentions 17-21 inch forged wheel sizes), and Contact form submits with success message shown.
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory chat_sessions dict in server.py will not scale horizontally or survive restarts — for future-proofing, rebuild LlmChat context from Mongo chat_messages on cache miss.
No rate limiting on /api/chat or /api/enquiries — could be abused. Consider slowapi or reverse-proxy limits.
EnquiryCreate.email uses plain str — swap to EmailStr for validation.
Chat error handler emits a generic fallback but the streaming HTTP status stays 200 — clients cannot distinguish real answers from failures programmatically.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ enquiry created via automated tests and one via Playwright contact form.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, chat SSE streaming, multi-turn context, chat history persistence, enquiry create+list+newest-first, and 422 validation. All 8 tests pass in ~8s. Frontend Playwright verified intro splash + skip + no-reappear, 6-route navigation, chat streaming (allow ~25s for Gemini response), and contact form success state.
